description: This file defines internal structures, macros, and function prototypes for the T2 component in a telemetry system, including component configuration, state management, and logging controls.

methods.name: ComponentCommonDmInit
methods.description: Initializes a COMPONENT_COMMON_DM structure with default values.

methods.name: ComponentCommonDmClean
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for the Name and Author fields of COMPONENT_COMMON_DM.

methods.name: ComponentCommonDmFree
methods.description: Cleans and frees the COMPONENT_COMMON_DM structure.

methods.name: cmd_dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches commands based on input command code.

methods.name: load_data_model
methods.description: Loads the data model for the component.

methods.name: ssp_create_t2
methods.description: Creates and initializes the T2 component.

methods.name: ssp_engage_t2
methods.description: Engages or starts the T2 component.

methods.name: ssp_cancel_t2
methods.description: Cancels or stops the T2 component.
